svg.title: Killing a worker mid-stream
svg.desc: One of 4 workers was killed after 161,150 events and restarted 20 seconds later. Events published 498,360, stored 498,360, lost 0. The final snapshots matched an undisturbed run exactly. 48,000 redelivered events were all skipped.
svg.text: kill -9 one of 4 workers, restart it 20 s later
